title: VoxelVerse
tagline: This project will be an open-world MetaVerse with a community driven game mechanic.
description: The premise of the game is to collect resources and use those resources to live in the game. The assets live on IPFS and the NFT's are powered by the polygon blockchain for it's low transaction fees and fast execution. The game itself uses Valist for the decentralized distribution of the game and for adding a game economy for downloads overall plays of the game.
how_its_made: This game uses IPFS for storing game assets and uses Unity Asset Addressables in-game. The network of choice is Polygon for signing and NFT creation. Valist is used for the decentralized distribution of the game a game economy for downloads and overall plays of the game as a new area for game developers to continually earn income and add a community DOA system.
